data.long_meaning: Means the one who is determined and victorious. Derived from the Arabic root 'farqa' which means to separate, to distinguish, and to excel. The name Farqad carries the meaning “Determined, Victorious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Farqad usually hope their child will grow to embody determined, victorious and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: The name Farqad is a powerful one in Islamic culture, evoking images of strength, determination, and courage. It is a name for a leader who is able to distinguish between right and wrong, and is not afraid to stand up for what is just and true. In many ways, Farqad represents the ideals of Islamic warrior-scholars, such as those of the early Islamic Caliphate or the later Mughals of India. With this name, a child is given a strong foundation on which to build a character that is both courageous and wise.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Farqad carries a deeper meaning. It embodies the concept of discernment, or knowing the difference between the material and the spiritual. In Islamic teachings, the pursuit of knowledge and understanding of God is a central tenet. Farqad, by his ability to distinguish and excel, serves as an inspiration for all Muslims to continually strive towards this goal. Additionally, the name can be seen as a reminder of the importance of making clear-headed decisions based on truth and wisdom, rather than rash emotions or base desires. Ultimately, Farqad represents a person who is living in accordance with the guidance of God, and is therefore imbued with both worldly strength and spiritual enlightenment.
